_provenance.source: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised edition (Hoffleit & Warren 1991)
_provenance.note: Real stars at real positions, replacing a decorative starfield. Positions are J2000 mean places: proper motion is not applied, which moves the fastest stars by under an arcminute per century and nothing at all at this rendering scale.
_provenance.acknowledgement: This research has made use of the VizieR catalogue access tool, CDS, Strasbourg, France (DOI 10.26093/cds/vizier).
